summary: Iteration 52 — RETEST of iteration_51 pricing bugs on frontend Checkout.jsx. Both critical bugs are FIXED. End-to-end verified with real UI + real bookings: (a) Checkout preview now sends `address` on /bookings/cart-quote so city-based surge (Patna 15%) appears in the preview; (b) coupon validation now validates against the WHOLE cart (POST /bookings/validate-coupon with items[]+address+schedule_type). Preview total matches Σ(created booking totals) to the paisa (₹1,188.73). Coupon negative gate works (SAVE100 rejected on ₹199 single-item cart) and MONSOON20 accepted on ₹399 Bathroom Cleaning.

ui_bugs.component: Checkout.jsx — Price details section (StepSummary lines 892-923) & Category-wise charges table (lines 862-890)
ui_bugs.issue: No explicit 'Surge' row is rendered anywhere in the Price details or the category-wise breakdown. The numeric total is correct (surge is folded into Taxable amount), but from the customer's viewpoint there is an unlabelled ~₹131 delta between Services+Visiting and Taxable in the multi-category test (876+100 → 1107.4). Request explicitly asked that 'a Surge row MUST now appear in the preview'. Backend already returns pricing.surge; suggest adding `{totals.surge > 0 && <Row l="Surge" v={fmt(totals.surge)} />}` above the Taxable row, plus a Surge column in the category-charges table using c.surge_charge (if apportioned).

action_items: Add an explicit 'Surge' Row in Price details (and a 'Surge' column in Category-wise charges) so the customer sees the ₹131.40 charge instead of it being silently baked into 'Taxable amount'. Data is already present at cart-quote.pricing.surge and per-category on category_charges[].surge_charge.
critical_code_review_comments: Checkout.jsx:196 now correctly ships `address: addr` in the cart-quote payload — surge/serviceability are reflected in the preview. ✔
Checkout.jsx:248 applyCoupon now sends the FULL items[] + address + schedule_type — full-cart min_order gate works. ✔
Checkout.jsx:208-211 gracefully clears an applied coupon if cart-quote later reports coupon_applied=false (with a user message). ✔
Missing surge line in Price details — see UI bug above.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for invariant Σ==preview and coupon validation; 1 UX transparency gap (no Surge row)

rca of the issue: Iteration_51 root causes both remediated: (1) cart-quote payload now carries `address` and re-fires on addr.city/pincode/lat/lng change (Checkout.jsx:196,221); (2) applyCoupon now sends {code, items:map(toReqItem), schedule_type, address} instead of items[0] only (Checkout.jsx:248). Backend endpoint /bookings/validate-coupon dispatches to validate_cart_coupon when items[] present. Only remaining UX gap: the Surge value is not displayed as a labelled line in the Price details or category-wise table — the customer sees the delta absorbed into 'Taxable amount' without explanation.
